skills.title: Zeabur + GitHub Three-Way Sync Deploy
skills.description: Publish a local project to a Zeabur server with GitHub-based three-way sync (local ↔ GitHub ↔ Zeabur), auto-redeploying on every git push. Orchestrates the zeabur:* skills in the right order and bakes in the non-obvious gotchas that block first-time setups.
